intro.summary: Southwest inner-city community on both sides of Crowchild Trail, between 17 and 33 Avenue SW, known for new semi-detached infills on split lots.
intro.body: Richmond (Richmond/Knob Hill) lies on both sides of Crowchild Trail between 17 Avenue SW and 33 Avenue SW, next to Killarney and the former Currie Barracks lands. Its streets of 1940s and 1950s houses have seen many lots redeveloped into pairs of semi-detached infills.
